MyFitnessPal User - Not as good. My review comes from a MyFitnessPal user with a 2500+ login streak. As a long time MyFitnessPal user, Carb Manager might just not be for me personally. 

Pros:
- Great free features (barcode scanning, macro/net carb focus)
- Good food database (found some missing items)
- Love love love the weekly progress report emails
- The net carb centric streaks and tracking / progress bars are perfect

Cons:
- Very impactful annoyances with the UX for entering food
- Food scanning quick button pops in during food entering workflow, pushing critical UI and causing mis-taps on filter button (pushing/hiding UI like buttons dynamically is a huge no-no)
- Food search UI has inferior capabilities (results are not remembered for fast lookup) Favorites can be used, but favorites isn’t automatically selected. Sometimes favorites doesn’t actually work (favorites food results missing). Adding frequent food is a 3-4 tab nightmare workflow
- No “grouped” foods quick add features (in MyFitnessPal, you can scroll down when adding a food and quick add all foods that are also commonly eaten with that food during that window in the day)
- No dark mode
- The UI feels cluttered. There’s something about the heading font size or font type or info cell background/borders where everything gets lost. It takes several seconds to read what day I’m looking at. 

Despite great free features and net carb centric tracking (features I want), the UX usability issues above prevent me from switching off MyFitnessPal. 

I’d consider trying Carb Manager again and change my review if the missing features I mentioned actually are available, and the usability issues above are addressed.

I can save that for future use as well. And it’s not just the ingredients. You can enter the steps to make the meal. There have been a few times that I’ve made a new dish and family members have asked for the recipe and I can email them the step by step instructions. 
The app has helped me learn what is in the foods I eat. I don’t have to use it as often as a did at the start because the repetition has helped me remember the carbs that are in the foods that I eat most often. I honestly don’t know how I would have completely changed my eating habits without this app. It has been invaluable for me. If you’re need to make a drastic change to your carb intake, this is an app for you. My medical issues are now under control and I lost about 40lbs as an unintended side effect. So win win.
